name: earth-wall-blocker
intent: Five faceted stone slabs rise staggered from below to form a protective wall — EXPOSED flips to PROTECTED.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Wall resolves directly to raised/PROTECTED; no staggered rise

acceptance: Exactly 5 faceted slabs (clip-path polygons) with alternating heights 86/92/100/92/86%
Each slab rises risePx 118 with slabMs 280 and staggerMs 55 between starts (riseTotalMs 500)
Zone label switches EXPOSED → PROTECTED and status WALL UP after settleMs 150
Replay lowers all slabs then re-runs the stagger rise
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows raised wall immediately with animations disabled
